description: 修复对话按钮CSS样式和搜索技能关键词匹配排序

userStories.title: 修复对话按钮 CSS 样式（保留删除功能）
userStories.description: As a user, I want conversation list buttons to have the original purple theme styling (hover highlight, active state, text overflow ellipsis) while keeping the delete button for each conversation.
acceptanceCriteria: 删除 App.css 中旧的 .conversation-item / .conversation-item:hover / .conversation-item.active 规则（约第156-180行）
新增 .conversation-item-wrapper CSS：display:flex, align-items:center, border-radius:6px, hover背景 rgba(139,92,246,0.1), active背景 rgba(139,92,246,0.15)
新增 .conversation-item-btn CSS：flex:1, min-width:0, text-align:left, text-overflow:ellipsis, padding:10px 12px, border-radius:6px, font-size:14px, white-space:nowrap, overflow:hidden
新增 .conversation-delete-btn CSS：默认 display:none, wrapper hover时 display:flex, 独立hover变红色(error), disabled时opacity:0.4

userStories.title: 修复搜索技能关键词匹配与排序
userStories.description: As a user, I want different skill keywords (e.g. 'Python' vs 'Java') to produce meaningfully different job rankings, with better-matched jobs appearing first, sorted by match count then salary. Multiple queries in the same conversation should all return results.
acceptanceCriteria: _fetch_jobs_from_db 排序从'仅按 salary_max'改为'按技能匹配数 desc → salary_max desc'（匹配越多越靠前）
_keyword_score 加入 title 字段匹配（原来只搜 description + skills_json），标题命中权重 ×2
薪资阈值 MIN_SALARY_THRESHOLD = 10000 保持不变
所有平台（BOSS直聘、今日招聘等）岗位统一混合输出，不区分 source
搜索 'Python Django' 时，标题含这两个关键词的岗位排在前面
搜索 'Java Spring' 时，与 'Python Django' 的结果排序有明显差异
